["Styret i Mentor Medier har i dag godkjent årsregnskapet og årsgberetningen for 2020.Mentor Medier hadde i 2020 en EBITDA på 28,7 millioner kroner, en økning på 4,4 millioner kroner fra 2019. Det er gledelig at den positive resultatutviklingen fortsetter i 2020, ikke minst tatt i betraktning de negative konsekvensene av koronasituasjonen. I 2019 var det en engangseffekt på 5,8 millioner kroner knyttet til salget av Programbladet, så den reelle forbedringen er dermed enda større. Abonnementsinntektene har i 2020 økt med 11,3 millioner kroner fra 2019 (ekskl. Morgenbladet). Våre publikasjoner har hatt en god opplagsutvikling som først og fremst skyldes økning i antall digitale abonnement. Mentor Medier sine aviser har til sammen ca. 90.000 betalende abonnenter, hvorav ca. 30 % er rene digitale abonnenter. Annonseinntektene har hatt en negativ utvikling, først og fremst som følge av koronasituasjonen. Totalt er det en nedgang i annonseinntektene på 10,4 millioner (ekskl. Morgenbladet). Den negative effekten er størst for Dagsavisen. Omsetningen i konsernet er på 514 millioner kroner i 2020, 41 millioner kroner høyere enn i 2019. Den største årsaken til økningen i omsetningen er at regnskapet for Morgenbladet er konsolidert inn i konsernregnskapet fra 1. juli 2020. Det er for øvrig også en mindre økning i inntektene når en ser bort fra effekten som skyldes Morgenbladet. Ordinær generalforsamling vil bli avholdt digitalt den 29.april 2021 kl. 15.00. Innkallingen til generalforsamlingen vil bli sendt ut 14 dager i forkant av generalforsamlingen."]
["MENTOR: Polaris Media blir deleier i Mentor Medier og partene inngår en strategisk samarbeidsavtale", "Company news", "2021-03-10 12:00:19"]

["PRESSEMELDING ONSDAG 10. MARS 2021Polaris Media blir deleier i Mentor Medier og partene inngår en strategisk samarbeidsavtale- Gjennom den strategiske samarbeidsavtalen skal vi finne frem til løsninger som kan styrke begge parter, sier Per Axel Koch, konsernsjef i Polaris Media og Per Magne Tveiten, konsernsjef i Mentor Medier. Polaris Media og Mentor Medier inngår en strategisk samarbeidsavtale. Gjennom samarbeidet vil Mentor Medier få tilgang til større ressurs- og utviklingskapasitet og være bedre rustet i den pågående digitale transformasjonen. Polaris Media vil med dette få økt volum, noe som gir potensiale for enda bedre produkter og tjenester i fremtiden. Som en del av dette er det inngått en egen samarbeidsavtale om annonsetjenester, som i første omgang gjelder for Dagsavisen. Videre er det også avtalt at flere av avisene til Mentor Medier skal trykkes desentralisert i Polaris Trykk på Stord og i Trondheim. Konkretisering av øvrige samarbeidsområder skal partene arbeide videre med. Polaris Media kjøper også 12 % av aksjene i Mentor Medier. Mentor Medier har en aksjepost på 17,8 % egne aksjer, og det er en del av denne aksjeposten som nå selges til Polaris Media. Transaksjonen omfatter 690.977 aksjer, til en pris på kr 41,- pr aksje. Total kjøpesum for aksjeposten er dermed 28,3 millioner kroner. - Vi er godt fornøyde med at Mentor Medier har fått en publisistisk deleier som er langsiktig og opptatt av å styrke og utvikle mediemangfold. Mentor Medier har hatt en svært god utvikling de siste årene. Med kjøpet av Morgenbladet i fjor har vi blitt en enda større mediegruppering. Vi har god utvikling i antall abonnenter, ikke minst som følge av sterk digital vekst. Samtidig ser vi behovet for å samarbeide med et miljø som gjør at vi kan være bedre rustet for fremtiden enn vi klarer på egen hånd, sier konsernsjef i Mentor Medier Per Magne Tveiten. - Vi ser med spenning frem til et tettere samarbeid med Mentor Medier, som består av sterke mediehus med en lang historie. Vi håper særlig å kunne bidra i den digitale transformasjonen. Mediehusene i Mentor Medier er godt i gang med dette arbeidet, men kravene til å kunne jobbe stadig mer analytisk og innsiktsbasert, gjør det viktigere enn noen gang å være med i et større fellesskap. Derfor har vi tro på at dette partnerskapet vil være av stor verdi for både Mentor og Polaris, sier Per Axel Koch, konsernsjef i Polaris Media.Mentor Medier har nærmere 1.000 aksjonærer. Polaris Media vil med dette aksjekjøpet bli den største aksjonæren i selskapet. De 25 største aksjonærene eier til sammen ca. 80 % av aksjene etter transaksjonen. Om Mentor Medier:Mentor Medier er et skandinavisk mediekonsern med hovedkontor i Oslo. Ambisjonen er å være det beste eiermiljøet for medieselskaper med ulike verdimessige og ideologiske ståsteder. De største avisene i konsernet er Vårt Land, Dagsavisen, Morgenbladet, samt Dagen i Sverige. Konsernet eier også blant annet Mediaconnect som er en sentral leverandør til mediebransjen. Mentor Medier har til sammen ca. 90.000 abonnenter, og konsernet har en årlig omsetning på ca. 550 millioner kroner, og er notert på NOTC-listen. Om Polaris Media:Polaris Media er et av Skandinavias største mediehus- og trykkerikonsern. Konsernet har virksomhet i store deler av Norge, samt på vestkysten i Sverige, totalt 59 mediehus, 7 trykkeri og 6 regionale distribusjonsselskaper. Polaris Media er eier i store mediehus som Adresseavisen, Fædrelandsvennen og Göteborgs-Posten, og har totalt ca. 574.000 abonnenter. Konsernet har en årlig omsetning på ca. 3,4 mrd. kr, og er notert på Oslo Børs. ["A Year of Reset, Focus and Forward Momentum2025 was a defining year for 00Nation. Rather than pursuing growth at any cost, theCompany deliberately focused on completing a foundational reset: simplifying the Groupstructure, reducing fixed costs, strengthening governance, and positioning the business forscalable and sustainable growth.During the year, the Group completed a significant transition phase, including the relocationof full operational activity to the United Kingdom, the establishment of a strengthenedoperating model, a clear separation between B2B and B2C activities, and a full reset of thefixed cost base. This work has created a more focused, disciplined and scalable platformas we enter 2026.With these changes largely complete, we believe 00Nation is well positioned to win in 2026,with a clear and credible path toward profitability around mid-year, subject to executionand market conditions.Relocation of Operations and Cost Base Reset:A core strategic decision during 2025 was to consolidate the Groups operations in the UK,where the majority of commercial activity, partners, talent and execution capability arebased.At the same time, operations in Norway were intentionally scaled down. Fixed costs associated with offices, staffing and local operations in Norway have now been reduced toalmost zero. 00Nation AS remains the listed parent company, but no longer carries a legacyoperational cost base in Norway.This transition has materially improved cash efficiency, reduced complexity, and aligned thecost structure with revenue-generating activity.A Leaner Organisation and Clearer Structure:Alongside the geographic relocation, the Group restructured its operating model.The organisation now operates with a small, experienced core team supported by specialistcontractors, partners and advisors. This model provides flexibility, access to world-classcapability, and the ability to scale activity without rebuilding fixed costs.Equally important, the Group completed a clearer structural separation between B2B andB2C activities, improving commercial focus, accountability and visibility across thebusiness.Operational Progress and Momentum:00Nation  Culture, Content and Clothing00Nation continues to build its position as a culture-led media and commerce platformoperating at the intersection of sport, content and community.Content output, audience growth and engagement remain strong across key platforms,providing a solid foundation for monetisation through advertising, partnerships and ownedproducts.Key developments include: Continued growth across social media Progress towards diversified revenue streams, including advertising, brandpartnerships, 00 Product ranges and formats partnerships, own product lines and formats. Expansion of content formats and live concepts designed to support long-term IPdevelopment. Ongoing development of the 00Nation clothing range, with product quality testingcompleted to leading industry benchmarks and all products designed, sampled andproduction-ready. Packaging, brand guidelines and digital infrastructure, including website and globalfulfilment, are progressing in parallel to support a coordinated global launch. During the prolonged pilot and testing phase, continued growth across the internetwith consistently high engagement levels, and across global audiencesCreative and Commercial Services:Our B2B business has delivered steady operational performance throughout 2025 and hasbeen profitable since September 2025.The business benefits from a diversified client base, a lean cost structure, and a growingreputation as a culture-focused execution partner for global brands.Recent highlights include: Delivery of multiple high-profile brand activations. A growing base of retainers and project work, supporting more predictablerevenues. Progress in formalising our operating model to support growth in 2026 whilemaintaining margin discipline. Increasing interest from both talent and brand partners, strengthening future dealflow.Our profitability and cash contribution represent an important stabilising element within theGroup.Brand Redesign and Positioning:During 2025, the Group completed a comprehensive redesign of the 00Nation brand.This work clarified positioning, strengthened coherence between B2B and B2C activities,and aligned the brand with its culture-led, international ambitions. The redesigned brandplatform is now being deployed across content, partnerships and product, forming aconsistent foundation for future growth.Strategic Partnerships and Market Positioning:The Group has made meaningful progress in discussions with several global partnersacross media monetisation, travel, sport and culture.These relationships are expected to enhance access to commercial opportunities,distribution and international scale, while reinforcing the Groups credibility with globalbrands and partners.Financial Discipline and Outlook:The Group continues to operate with a strong focus on financial discipline: Monthly fixed costs have been materially reduced and stabilised. Our B2B business is profitable and contributing positively to cash flow. 00Nation is approaching operational breakeven, with improving revenue visibility. Cash management and cost control remain key priorities as the business transitionsinto a growth phase.Detailed financial statements and projections are being prepared in line with audit andgovernance processes.Governance, Reporting and 2024 Accounts:The submission of the 2024 annual accounts was later than initially anticipated. This wasdriven by the scale of structural changes undertaken during the year and the need toaddress historical accounting missteps fully. These matters have now been resolved. Thework completed during this process has strengthened accounting processes and improvedcontrols. As a result, 2025 accounting and reporting are in good shape.Losses in 2024 were lower than in 2023 and were in line with investor expectations,planning and the Companys funding strategy.Looking Ahead to 2026:With the foundational rebuild largely complete, the Group enters 2026 with: A clearer strategic focus, A materially lower and more flexible cost base, Improved financial discipline and governance, Strengthened partnerships and execution capability, And multiple growth initiatives are progressing in parallel.Indicative 2026 Revenue Mix (Directional Guidance):The chart below illustrates managements current indicative view of the Groups 2026revenue composition, based on contracted revenues, high-confidence pipelines and provenoperating models. Figures are provided for illustrative purposes only and reflect directionalplanning assumptions rather than formal financial guidance. Talent Management: ~£0.8m Creative Services: ~£1.5m Brand Partnerships: ~£2m B2C (Media, Partnerships & Commerce): ~£2mAs the Group enters 2026, managements focus moves decisively from transition to valuecreation. On the B2B side, the priority is to fully validate our B2B business as a scalablemedia and entertainment business built on culture, talent and recurring commercialrelationships. This includes continuing to attract high-quality brands and talent,strengthening recurring revenues and building defensible IP and contracts.On the B2C side, the focus is on scaling owned, culturally relevant products and platformsin a disciplined and capital-efficient manner. During 2026, the objective is to establishprofitability, stability and repeatable growth across media, community and commerce,before accelerating scale in subsequent years. Over time, this approach is intended tocreate durable consumer IP, predictable cash flows and increasing optionality forshareholders.Management views a 57 year horizon as the normal timeframe for meaningfulbreakthrough and value crystallisation in global media and entertainment businesses andbelieves the foundations now in place are aligned with that trajectory.Taken together, these initiatives mark the conclusion of the Companys transition from aNorwegian esports-led organisation into a global media, entertainment and culture-drivenbusiness. With the cost base reset, governance strengthened and core platforms validated,management believes the Group is positioned to build long-term shareholder value throughsustained growth, asset creation and improving profitability.For further information, please contact David Williams Head of Business Affairs dw@00nation.comTlf. +44 77950 63636"]

["00NATION becomes largest shareholder in Guild Esports PLC", "Company news", "2024-01-31 16:57:44"]

["00NATION has invested NOK 6.6 million in Guild Esports PLC to become its largest shareholder, holding 13.54% of its shares. The two companies continue to discuss further alignment and opportunity. 00NATION went live in the Nordics in late 2021 and has combined media and wider youth culture with esports. Following its success in this space, 00Nation established a base in the UK in 2023, and will continue to focus on youth culture while partnering with Guild on professional esports. Guild is led by an experienced management team of entertainment sector and esports veterans and co-owned by David Beckham who is also the company Ambassador. Guild partners with a number of key brands including Sky Broadband, Subway, Secret Lab and Fanatec. The Company is headquartered in the UK and its shares are listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange (ticker: GILD) and on the OTCQB Venture Market in the United States (ticker: GULDF).Weve entered the third year of developing our company and are seeing success across the wider youth culture, and are now increasing our focus to build and scale. Esports has been a low impact but highly demanding part of our overall business, and brand partners, talent and audience are looking much wider. 00NATION fits the wider gaming and youth culture audience, while Guild Esports, and an esports education and performance driven management fits perfectly esports. We believe that two brands will cover more ground and be more effective with increased focus and budgets, representing gaming from two different perspectives. 00Nation will focus on mainstream media, entertainment and sports, while supporting Guild to drive esports forward. This is one of multiple pieces of news which will be announced in the near future, forming the 00Nation platform and driving scalability. Stay Tuned. - David Williams, Head of Business Affairs, PR & Media, 00NATION \"We are excited to see where this investment and opportunity takes us. Guild Esports is a great company with an exciting vision and team to execute it. 00Nation are in the process of fully launching across the wider youth and gaming culture, with individual brand focus. The investment in Guild and the redirection of the esport business thrust will allow us to divest our esports assets, in order to fully support Guild in that space, and their vision - nurturing young talent, their academy and strong focus on professional esports\"- Adrian Le Dantec, Head of Operations, Talent & Brand, 00NATION"]
["00NATION completes a year of transformation with the first eight figure brand partnership, opening up in the UK and pre acquisition talks", "Company news", "2023-11-03 21:21:50"]

["It may have been quiet to the outside, but from the inside, 00NATION has worked relentlessly to set the foundation to achieve its vision. Key highlights and comments:  Sold the Brazilian operation for an eight figure amount in June, to focus on the Nordics, UK and USA.«The Brazilian angle was a good opener, but it didnt fit the overall strategy and with an ocean between us and cultural and language barriers, it was hard to align and manage. Its a good group of people and theyll manage fine on their own.» - David Williams, 00NATION Opened up the UK operation to launch the brand and interconnect our roots in the Nordics with the goal of opening up in the USA.«Its always been the plan: Nordics, UK and USA. Back in May, we decided its time to get moving. In August we set up the first people there. In October we are seeing more activity in and around 00NATION than ever before. It was definitely the right move». - Sebastian Geurts, 00NATION  00NATION is in the final stages of the acquisition of a UK based, special operations team focused on gaming and esports, now to become 00NATION. With this acquisition, 00NATION has on boarded one of the most accomplished management teams across gaming and esports with executive backgrounds from IMG, Universal Music, Spotify and Sports Recruitment International. They bring execution power and relationships across the global media industry, gaming sector and sportsworld, and minimum 40 Mill NOK of expected annual revenues generated through marketing services.  The deal terms will be disclosed in due course. It is based on a pure equity swap with no cash component. «They add tremendous execution power, opportunities and experience to the organization. We work together like a real squad should do and the last two months have shown more results and future promise than the entirety of a whole year in the Nordics. They have the right understanding of the vision, sense of urgency to execute, and stickiness to see it through''. - Sebastian Geurts, 00NATION «The core team has it. Getting to know Sebastian closely, he is a truly inspirational leader who has the potential to supercharge our combined business. The media, sports and entertainment landscape is in transition and 00NATION has the right vision and approach to become a key player in the bigger game focused on youth audiences. Thats why we joined, to execute on the 00NATION vision. Its the answer to what the landscape needs''. - Managing Director, Acquisition target  00NATION is in final stages of the acquisition of majority shareholding in a nordic consumer tech company focused on live shopping and community driven commerce. 00NATION is trading resources for majority ownership, no cash or equity swap component. The company brings a successful live shopping environment, solid proof of concepts and a client list of nordic and international brands. The application is expected to launch as the 00NATION main website with social and shopping capabilities, making 00NATION, talent and brand partner products available through our own platform. The platform will also function in a stand-alone environment.«This is another step towards diversifying revenues, and also strengthening the offering to brand partners, talent and eventually our own community. More information to come soon». - Sebastian Geurts, 00NATION«We have the tech and the live shopping track record. 00NATION has exactly what we need to scale, both in the nordics and in the UK, and will be excellent contribution to our shareholder base, leadership team and core development as a brand and as a company.» - Chairman, Acquisition Target  00NATION has stepped away from the predecessors traditional sponsorship deals to all encompassing brand partnerships: Strategizing, creating, executing and distributing together with the partners: Partnerships fully focused on connecting, integrating and scaling across the youth. Minimum brand partnerships have increased to 3 000 000 NOK per year. First fully international partnership is signed with minimum annual revenues breaking eight figures. The expectations of landing multiple similar partnerships within the next 6 months are high.«We have never loved the sponsorship approach. We are here to solve real problems for our brand partners and to have real impact. That comes with a combination of executing well within our own universe, stretching and scaling beyond our own universe together with our partners. It was so good to see the strategy working out. The effort we put in for our partners is heavy and with global brands and larger markets, the budgets are bigger and it becomes easier to justify and succeed in the local markets. It took two months to establish the first big partnership in the UK and we are well positioned to keep going.» - Paul Davis, 00NATION «00NATION differentiates itself from traditional gaming and esports companies by focusing on what the brand needs, offering creative and strategic solutions, and also executing towards that. They live and breathe youth culture and have deep insights to different verticals and the crossover culture. We are very excited about the partnership and are hoping for many fruitful years to come» - Stefan Vermeul, HP Inc.  00NATION has been active on the talent side, creating the foundation for talent to reach their true potential. Core talents are all committed on multi-year long contracts including Herman Tømmeraas, Mr Savage, Truls Torp, Mini-Kim, Sean Sagar and Benny Central. The talent dealflow is up significantly in the Nordics and the UK including collaborations with Asos, Coca Cola, Hugo Boss and Breitling.  The overall growth is up significantly with much deeper aggregated activity levels and footprint across the internet  The talent team is seeing constant progress, focusing on scalability and evolving the execution power and overall services«00NATION was struggling to scale its team and services on the talent side according to its promise to be a full 360 management across the youth. We have overcome that barrier and found the right people and model to deliver a wider range of services for a wider range of talent. Forward, well see a significant increase in talent from different verticals from music and gaming to motorsport and outdoors»- Adrian Le Dantec, 00NATION «00NATION changed our lives forever. We have never worked harder and never had more progress. Its an unbelievable team with a warm family feeling. It is completely surreal to be approached by fans at different airports around the world, being part of the 00NATION family and so many talented people. It is a dream coming true».- Truls Torp and Kim Knutsen 00NATION initiated a pilot to fully launch its own brand. The pilot was focused on YouTube, one weekly long form episode a week and centered around action sports. Targets to meet between February and December: - 50 000 subscribers - 20% engagement - 30% watch rate - One upload per week All the targets were met during September.«The early stages of YouTube are particularly hard and to build a global audience from Norway is even harder. The pilot has superseded its criteria and the project is thriving. The watch time is often above 50%, the engagement is great and the team has shown that they can lift the project all the way. The learning picked up is invaluable and we are now looking to launch the full brand with multiple verticals and dedicated teams, talent and channels per vertical, increased activities and larger formats connecting and unifying the verticals. We have achieved what we wanted in 2023, its aligned with the vision and we are looking forward to fully launching and scaling the brand during 2024.»- Sebastian Geurts, 00NATION Since the last conversion in August, funds committed on NOK 7 per share in 2023 are NOK 16 million and funds pre-committed in 2024 on NOK 7 per share are above NOK 21 million. Existing shareholders will have the opportunity to participate in a NOK 7 per share repairing round. We expect a much higher pick up rate on revenues which will decrease the burn. The costs will slightly increase in the UK and decrease in the Nordics. The burn is higher in Q4 because we moved away from nordic brands to global brands, we are in transition to cut costs and add newly contracted revenues. We still expect to reach profitability in 2024.«We have raised using convertible notes for several reasons, the key reason being flexibility in uncertain times of how much, what price, and when. This has allowed us to form and grow, taking real steps towards the vision. The committed and pre committed funding will see us to operational profitability. The conversion in August was executed according to plan and the next conversion will be part of a traditional subscription and share issuance. We have not set the parameters yet, but we expect to raise a minimum NOK 50 million on NOK 12-15 per share, including the pre committed funding. We have no reason to believe we cannot execute towards that, considering we have raised over NOK 70 million during 2022 and 2023, this will allow us to scale, fund working capital for our increasing stable of growth brand partners, and to take advantage of strategic market opportunities which are presenting during this current economic environment in media, sports and entertainment. We had to make some temporary write-offs against some of the early deals and it weakened the balance sheet. However these can be reversed if and when we restart operations in these areas. The balance during 2023-2024 will strengthen dramatically with the capital in, revenue generating and profitable acquisitions, and with overall increased company focus and performance».- Sebastian Geurts, 00NATION Asking the core team about 2023:«We are proud of this year. It was a tough year with low salaries, low liquidity and a lot of sacrifices. The transformation has put us in a position to ramp up tempo to scale our holy trinity of brand partnerships, talent management and our own brand and universe, while becoming more and more of a well functioning machinery. Next year we will be underperforming if we dont hit the 100 Mill NOK revenue mark. That together with rolling out the brand in five core verticals and executing on the full content plan, launching the core and nano talent programs, and to plant our flag firmly in UK soil while keeping our roots, those are the goals for 2024. If we hit them all, 2025 will be even more explosive».Contact:Sebastian Geurts (sg@00nation.com)CEODavid Williams (dw@00nation.com)Head of Business Affairs"]

["00NATION continues the growth trajectory and doubles up revenues from NOK 6,150K in Q1 2022 to NOK 14,896K in Q1-23. Along with the current member Dariusz Mioduski, each will bring a unique and proactive contribution to 00NATIONI have been watching 00Nation with interest and growing excitement over the last year, and tracking their progress. When I was invited to join the Board as Chairman I was truly honoured and proud to be helping out creating the new media house of the future . Its a great team and a great vision and I know its going to be an amazing journey Runar Eidsaa (Chairman of the Board)00NATION recent changes to management are the following: Stein Willmann is replaced by Christian Aass, and Steffen Willumsen is replaced by Elin Haukvik. Christian (previously TRY) has been around since September 2021 and Elin (previously Splay) has been around since September 2022. This concludes the management with the following team: Sebastian Geurts (CEO), Christian Aass (COO), Mats Vigeland (CMO), Paul Davis (Head of talent and PR), David Williams (Head of business affairs and investor relations), Elin Haukvik (Head of commercial partnerships), Adrian Le Dantec (Head of special projects), Ricardo Sinigaglia (Head of gaming and esports). \"In a fast paced environment, changes are natural. We are thankful for the time we had together. 00NATION has become a popular place to work and we are not only seeing evolution on a top level, CVs are pouring in and the entire organization is seeing a continuous uplift. It's been a challenging but giving journey so so far and it's a pleasure to work side by side with Sebastian and his creative intellect and extreme drive - Christian Aass, (COO)00NATION signs Øystein Holt (previously Unicare, Power, Idex Biometrics, BDO ) as new CFO, starting June 1st 2023.\"I'm thrilled to be joining the amazing 00NATION team!
